name: Checkers
description: Checkers (English draughts) against the computer or a second player. Tap one of your pieces to see where it can go and tap the square to move; a jump goes on by itself as far as it can, and a man reaching the far row is crowned king. Four levels for the computer, compulsory jumps on or off, who starts, and legal-move hints in the settings. Undo takes back your last move (and the computer's reply), and the game in progress is kept. Arrow keys and Enter play it from a keyboard. High contrast on black-and-white panels: white and black pieces on black squares.
